title: 第27章 咸豆腐脑
content_zh:
第27章 咸豆腐脑-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“不去。”

“为什么啊？赵霁不是跟那个导演认识吗？你和赵霁关系这么好。”

陈贺说的是《爱情公寓》，明天开始面试，他和几个同班同学约好了一起去。

本想拉着魏沐，没想到这小子不去。

“老陈，你放心吧，我早就和赵霁通过气，她会给你美言几句，你就放心演。保证有你的角色。”

我还不知道这小子在想什么？

别看陈贺在04级表演班人缘不错，但说起女人缘，他魏沐才是最好。

“你这....你知道....我不是这个意思。”

陈贺挠了挠头，有些不好意思。

幸好现在关着灯，否则就尴尬了。

“行了。你好好准备。明天争取拿下男主角。”

“没问题，等选上了哥请你吃饭。”

........

第二天，陈贺早早起床，看了看时间才七点。

小心翼翼的穿上衣服，来到洗手间刷牙洗脸。

等从洗手间出来，他注意到魏沐还在睡觉，便没有打扰。

到8点钟，魏沐才迷迷糊糊地睁开眼，这个时候陈贺已经回来，他正在穿衣服。

这小子穿的非常骚包，不知道的以为去婚礼当伴郎....

“桌子上有早餐，还是热的。”

“有咸豆腐脑没？”

“肯定有啊，咱们宿舍就你一个人吃咸豆腐脑，我能不知道？”

说起这个，对着镜子打扮的陈贺忍不住皱眉。

怎么会有人爱吃咸豆腐脑呢？那玩意是人吃的？

在他眼里，吃咸豆腐脑的都是异端，只有甜豆腐脑才是王道。

魏沐慢悠悠来到洗手间洗漱，等他洗完正看到陈贺在喷香水。

“大哥，你是去面试，不是去相亲，还特么喷香水，导演能闻到？”

“我这叫正式，这是态度，有的导演很看重这方面。”

懒得跟他争辩，魏沐来到桌上吃早餐。

没一会，陈贺跟他比了个OK手势。

“哥们走了。祝我凯旋归来！！！”

“一路走好。”

试镜地点就在上戏校内，《爱情公寓》本来就是广告电视剧，预算有限。

这些地方能省则省。

这部电影的导演叫韦正，但该剧真正的组建者则是汪远。

这哥们背景很牛，其祖父是以前上影副局长，父亲则是现在的上影副总裁。

人家才是真的二代。

《爱情公寓》这个项目就是汪远通过父亲的人脉接下来。

不像某些经常把自己爷爷挂嘴边的女明星，汪远为人比较低调。

面试地点是上戏的一个演播室，陈贺来的时候周围已经聚满了人。

他很快找到组织。

“赵霁，金铭，海陆”

"Not going."

"Why? Didn't Zhao Ji know the director? You and Zhao Ji have such a good relationship."

Chen He was talking about "Love Apartment". The interview would start tomorrow, and he made an appointment with several classmates to go together.

I wanted to take Wei Mu with me, but I didn't expect that this kid wouldn't go.

"Lao Chen, don't worry. I've had a bad relationship with Zhao Ji a long time ago. She will give you a few nice words, so you can act with confidence. I guarantee you will have a role."

I still don’t know what this kid is thinking?

Even though Chen He is popular in the 04-level acting class, when it comes to popularity with women, he, Wei Mu, is the best.

"You...you know...that's not what I meant."

Chen He scratched his head, a little embarrassed.

Fortunately, the lights are turned off now, otherwise it would be embarrassing.

"Okay. Get ready. Try to win the leading role tomorrow."

“No problem, I’ll treat you to dinner when I’m chosen.”

........

The next day, Chen He got up early and looked at the time, which was only seven o'clock.

I carefully put on my clothes and went to the bathroom to brush my teeth and wash my face.

When he came out of the bathroom, he noticed that Wei Mu was still sleeping, so he didn't disturb him.

At 8 o'clock, Wei Mu opened his eyes in a daze. By this time, Chen He had returned and was getting dressed.

This guy is dressed in a very slutty way. He thought he was going to be the best man at a wedding...

"There's breakfast on the table, and it's still hot."

“Do you have any salty tofu puffs?”

"There must be. You are the only one in our dormitory eating salted tofu. Can I know?"

Speaking of this, Chen He, who was dressing up in the mirror, couldn't help but frown.

How come some people like to eat salty tofu brain?Is that thing for human consumption?

In his eyes, those who eat salted tofu are heretics, and only sweet tofu is the way to go.

Wei Mu walked slowly to the bathroom to wash up. When he finished washing, he saw Chen He spraying perfume.

"Brother, you are going for an interview, not a blind date, and why are you wearing perfume? Can the director smell it?"

"I call this formality, this is attitude. Some directors attach great importance to this aspect."

Too lazy to argue with him, Wei Mu came to the table to have breakfast.

After a while, Chen He made an OK gesture with him.

"Brother is gone. Wish me a triumphant return!!!"

"Have a good trip."

The audition took place at the drama school. "Love Apartment" was originally an advertising TV series with a limited budget.

Save money if you can in these places.

The director of this film is Wei Zheng, but the real organizer of the play is Wang Yuan.

This guy has a great background. His grandfather was the former deputy director of Shanghai Film Academy, and his father is now the vice president of Shanghai Film Academy.

They are the real second generation.

The project "Love Apartment" was developed by Wang Yuan through his father's connections.

Unlike some female celebrities who often talk about their grandfather, Wang Yuan is relatively low-key.

The interview location was a studio where the show was located, and when Chen He arrived, the area was already full of people.

He quickly found the organization.

"Zhao Ji, Jin Ming, Hailu"
